_comment: Michael's actual capabilities, as data. Source: Michael, direct instruction to Agent 01, 2026-10-07 (FACT, owner-stated). Changing this file is an owner decision, not a code change.

skills.note: Do not give elementary advice (check compression/spark/fuel). Only model-specific, economically material guidance.

transport.note: A deal that requires a trailer is NOT rejected. Transport is an economic/logistics variable; a borrowed trailer must be confirmed with the lender before pickup.

logistics_difficulty_penalty.requires_trailer_borrowed: set by lane C economics config
logistics_difficulty_penalty.note: numeric penalties live in 03's scoring config, not here

deal_classes._status: PROVISIONAL: proposed by Agent 01 from Michael's training examples (ARIA-20261007-1840). Michael confirms or changes these (MICHAEL_DECISIONS #9). They are data, not code.

micro_flip.note: tiny exposure, same-day/next-day (e.g. a $30 TV that sells in an hour)

quick_turn.note: turns within about a week or so

capital_intensive_flip.note: large cash and/or long hold (e.g. a mower bought late in the season)

deal_classes.rule: Never reject a deal solely because expected gross profit is below an absolute amount. A $30 item that reliably becomes $75-100 in an hour can outrank a $250 item that becomes $600 in four months. Absolute profit, cash multiple, time-to-cash and downside stay separately visible.

current_cash_context.note: Michael-stated available cash / how tight funds are right now (capital-lockup sensitivity). null = UNKNOWN; the card then says so. Set by Michael only.

mission.provenance: protected_principal_usd: Michael via Aria ARIA-20261007-1905 (owner-set bankroll). weekly_target_usd/hours_available: UNKNOWN until Michael sets them (MICHAEL_DECISIONS #10); the package's $1,500 is an example.
